coldStart.policy: Mostly new verified rules; only bounded recent/weak review until broad syllabus exposure develops.

sourcePolicy: SSC official syllabus defines exam scope. Atomic rule truth must be verified against Cambridge English Grammar/Dictionary, British Council LearnEnglish, Merriam-Webster, or another comparably authoritative English-language reference. Coaching sites are not curriculum sources.
runtimePolicy: The Google Sheet is the curated workspace, but daily runtime never reads Google. Stage 3 performs an explicit validated snapshot sync into Supabase before Grammar is enabled.
